proposals.title: Pooling rule proposals
proposals.note: A tag fixed at the provider does not restate history; an approved rule with an effective date does. One person proposes, another approves, and both actions go to the decision ledger.

reconciliation.where: Allocated by entity and GL account
reconciliation.noItems: Ties to the cost rows: nothing to reconcile.

ledger.reconciliation_note: A difference that registered reconciling items account for (±$1) is labeled when they are explained, or awaiting when one is still open.
ledger.invoice_formula: Invoice line − Σ billed cost of its cost rows = the difference, explained by reconciling items. Allocated = Σ effective cost of the line's cost rows, split by entity and GL account; it ties to effective cost (C-10 for this line). Effective cost spreads commitment fees into the usage they cover, so billed and effective cost differ on usage and fee lines.

tags.formula: Coverage = spend whose required tags are all present and valid ÷ taggable spend, weighted by cost; by entity after allocation. Tax, credits, adjustments, fees, Marketplace purchases and usage with no resource id cannot be tagged and are reported apart, never as violations. Suspense = taggable spend with no cost center after tags and approved rules; it waits with an owner instead of being spread. Share = suspense ÷ cloud usage in the tagged accounts.
